items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: That was Frank Woerley. That was Frank Woerley too. Had that place. That's my knowing as far as I've been.

ctx.x: He had a saloon on Iberville and Basin though too I think. I think they had a trio sometimes, string trio with guitar and bass and there.
Yeah, but I don't, I can't think of it. That was Frank Woerley. That was Frank Woerley too. Had that place. That's my knowing as far as I've been.
